hooks.text: 主动封路截停怪物，让守卫获得更高效的集火窗口
hooks.excerpt: Player block road, monster stop. Stopped monster, defenders hit easy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 24种差异化守卫应对会耍花招的敌人与多变战场
hooks.excerpt: Defenders. 24 kinds. Different. Think long to choose. Enemy sneaky. Enemy use trick. Hard for defender to protect. Must win in different places. Must adapt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 海量怪物与强悍守卫共同构成荒诞搞笑的卡通防线
hooks.excerpt: There are tons of monsters and tough defenders in the game each of which fits perfectly into a funny cartoonish setting.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Графика на мой взгляд простая, но в то же время красивая.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 独特画风色彩丰富而充实。

excerpts.excerpt: 画风独特，色彩丰富且充实
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 防御塔存在Bug且行为不符合预期。

excerpts.excerpt: Towers are buggy and don't act as they should
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: Bug会让部分关卡几乎无法游玩。

excerpts.excerpt: the crappy interface and the bugs make the game nearly unplayable in some stages
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 缺少能力、升级和技能树说明。

excerpts.excerpt: complete lack of explaination for abilities, upgrades and the skill tree.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 最终Boss战帧率低至个位数。
普通难度在早期关卡过高。

excerpts.excerpt: It is WAY too difficult (on normal) by the third and fourth levels.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期怪物增多时优化变差并容易卡顿。

excerpts.excerpt: 游戏优化有点差，后期怪一多容易卡顿
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
